standards_review.notes: All commits in the branch follow EPMCDME-<n>: format. Branch name matches convention.

Apache 2.0 license headers present on all new files. set -euo pipefail used throughout hooks. Cyclomatic complexity well under gate=15 (max ~4 in pre_push.sh opt-in block). TDD approach with subprocess-style tests in tests/scripts/.

No user-controlled input injected into shell commands. No credentials or secrets exposed. File existence checked before read in commit_msg.sh. PYTEST_CMD/SONAR_CMD expansion is intentionally unquoted for multi-word commands (documented tradeoff, low risk in standard environments).

findings.title: REBASE_HEAD and CHERRY_PICK_HEAD bypass absent from commit_msg.sh
findings.problem: The committed script bypasses validation only for MERGE_HEAD. REBASE_HEAD (interactive rebase reword) and CHERRY_PICK_HEAD (cherry-pick --edit) are not checked. Git invokes the commit-msg hook in all three scenarios; the replayed or reworded message does not carry the EPMCDME- prefix.
findings.impact: Interactive rebase (reword/fixup mid-rebase) and cherry-pick workflows are hard-blocked. Developers cannot reword a commit mid-rebase or amend a cherry-picked commit without skipping hooks entirely.
findings.recommendation: Add `git rev-parse -q --verify REBASE_HEAD >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0` and the CHERRY_PICK_HEAD equivalent immediately after the MERGE_HEAD check. Working-tree fix is already present (uncommitted) — commit it.

findings.title: pass_filenames: true on codemie-commit-msg hook
findings.problem: The committed config sets pass_filenames: true on the commit-msg stage hook. Depending on pre-commit version, this can cause staged filenames to be passed alongside the commit-message file path, shifting $1 away from COMMIT_EDITMSG.
findings.impact: On affected pre-commit versions the hook reads a source file as the commit subject and produces a confusing rejection on every commit.
findings.recommendation: Set pass_filenames: false. Working-tree fix is already present (uncommitted) — commit it.

findings.title: Missing bypass tests: squash!, amend!, Revert, REBASE_HEAD, CHERRY_PICK_HEAD
findings.problem: The committed test file (7 tests) covers valid prefix, missing prefix, no-colon, Merge bypass, fixup!, MERGE_HEAD, and leading-comment. It does not test squash!, amend!, Revert subject bypasses, nor REBASE_HEAD or CHERRY_PICK_HEAD ref bypasses.
findings.impact: Regression in any of these bypass paths goes undetected by the test suite.
findings.recommendation: Add test_squash_message_bypassed, test_amend_message_bypassed, test_revert_message_bypassed, test_rebase_head_present_bypasses_validation, and test_cherry_pick_head_present_bypasses_validation. Working-tree fix (12 tests) is already present (uncommitted) — commit it.

findings.title: Fragile STUB_TEMPLATE and newline-count assertion
findings.problem: STUB_TEMPLATE echoes only $@ without the stub's name, making content-based identity assertions impossible. test_pytest_failure_blocks_and_skips_sonar asserts calls.count('\n') == 1 to infer sonar was skipped — this relies on incidental line count rather than which stub ran.
findings.impact: Silent false positives if sonar runs when it should be skipped, or false negatives on innocent template changes. Fragile across any change to stub invocation count.
findings.recommendation: Change STUB_TEMPLATE to log `$(basename "$0"): $@` so stub identity is captured. Assert `sonar_stub.sh not in calls` directly. Working-tree fix is already present (uncommitted) — commit it.

findings.title: CODEMIE_PREPUSH_ENABLED=1 and =on not tested
findings.problem: pre_push.sh accepts CODEMIE_PREPUSH_ENABLED=1 and =on via nocasematch, but the committed test suite only exercises the value true. Alternate truthy values have no regression guard.
findings.impact: A future refactor that removes or misplaces the nocasematch block silently breaks 1/on activation with no failing test.
findings.recommendation: Add test_numeric_one_enabled_runs and test_on_enabled_runs. Working-tree fix is already present (uncommitted) — commit it.

_deferred.title: Empty commit message produces misleading error
_deferred.problem: When the commit message file contains only blank lines and comment lines, subject remains empty and the hook exits 1 with 'Commit message must start with EPMCDME-<number>:' rather than 'message is empty'.
_deferred.rationale_for_defer: git itself rejects empty commit messages independently; the misleading error is cosmetic.

_deferred.title: Unquoted $PYTEST_CMD/$SONAR_CMD breaks on space-in-path
_deferred.problem: PYTEST_CMD and SONAR_CMD are expanded unquoted, relying on word-splitting for multi-word commands. Paths with spaces fail.
_deferred.rationale_for_defer: Standard Poetry/venv install paths do not contain spaces in this project's environment. Override vars are developer-controlled.

_deferred.title: Commit subject regex accepts EPMCDME-123:no-space
_deferred.problem: Regex ^EPMCDME-[0-9]+: does not require a space after the colon. The documented convention (shown in the error example) includes a space.
_deferred.rationale_for_defer: Policy/style concern only; does not cause hook failures or incorrect behavior. Team can tighten to ^EPMCDME-[0-9]+: if desired.
